mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.category_id, c.title, c.subtitle, c.cover_image, c.price, c.teacher_name, c.duration, c.difficulty, c.description, c.content, c.video_url, c.view_count, c.study_count, c.is_recommend, c.sort, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at, cc.name AS category_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN course_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.id AND cc.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED'
